name: flipdown-html5downloader
description: FlipDown — FlipHTML5 Downloader Web Application (PDF & Offline HTML5 Package Generator)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
